Public hearing to consider adoption of the El Camino Real Specific Plan (ECRSP) and related amendments to the Encinitas Zoning Regulations, the Land Use Element of the General Plan, and the Local Coastal Program. Environmental Considerations: Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15105(b), an Initial Study (IS) has been prepared which determined that no significant environmental impacts would result from the proposed project with mitigation measures incorporated into the project. Therefore, a Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND) was prepared for the project that includes mitigation measures for Biological Resources (BIO-1) and Tribal Cultural Resources (TCR-1) incorporated into the project as filed with the State Clearinghouse (State Clearinghouse No. 2024060039), and San Diego County Clerk-Recorder's Office. Contact Person: Housing Services Manager Dacey
1) Consider modifications to the El Camino Real Specific Plan as recommended by the Planning Commission and staff and provide direction as to which, if any, of the recommended modifications are to be included in the final Specific Plan; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-83, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program for the El Camino Real Specific Plan Project"; 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-84, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Figure 4 Land Use Policy: New Encinitas Map of the Land Use Element of the General Plan and Amending the Local Coastal Program"; 4) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2024-08, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting the El Camino Real Specific Plan (SP-6) and Amendments to Section 30.84.010 of Chapter 30.84 (Specific Plans) of the Zoning Regulations and the Local Coastal Program" with incorporation of recommended modifications as directed by City Council; and 5) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-85, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, to Authorize Submittal of the Local Coastal Program Amendments to Section 30.84.010 of Chapter 30.84 (Specific Plans) of the Zoning Regulations and Figure 4 Land Use Policy: New Encinitas Map of the Land Use Element of the General Plan to the California Coastal Commission".

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
